text:
Maya Chen: nightly-evals flagged a regression on the summarization prompt set for rwd-llama3-13b-int8. ROUGE-L down ~8 pts vs yesterday, and ~12% of runs returned truncated/empty outputs. attaching summary from the job: s3://redwood-nightlies/1973001111/report.json

Samir Patel: ugh. any obvious diff in quant profile or calib stats?

Maya Chen: quick diff shows a layer-scale shift in quant calibration for layers 22-26, scale mean increased ~1.9x. attaching histogram snapshot and per-layer scales. also saw more <EOS> tokens early in beam logs.

Olivia Park: can you dump a few failing examples? want to see if it's prompt tokenization or model-side.

Maya Chen: pasted 3 failing prompts and model outputs in the report. Example: prompt id 00042 -> expected 120 token summary, output was just "" (empty) or single punctuation. Logs show decode returned 0-length generation after sampling step 1.

Liam O'Neil: do we have FP8 run for the same commit? to confirm it's quant-specific.

Maya Chen: yes — FP8 baseline for same commit doesn't show the drop. FP8 ROUGE stable. INT8 only regressed after last quant-maint change (commit c3f9a2) that updated per-channel min/max aggregation.

Eva Gomez: cc @quant-ci-bot can you re-run the per-layer calibration with the previous aggregation (pre-c3f9a2) and with the new one but forcing cached calib stats? want to see if it reproduces.

quant-ci-bot: Re-run queued. experiment ids: exp-1973001-prevagg and exp-1973001-forcecache. estimated finish ~30m. logs -> https://ci.redwood.ai/exp/1973001

Samir Patel: while that's running, quick check: any tokenization version bumps? tokenizer v2.1 -> v2.2 changed BOS/EOS handling in some edge cases. Could that combine with early-eos bias from quant scales?

Olivia Park: good call — tokenizer diff is in today's deps. we should test with v2.1 too.

Maya Chen: ran a quick local repro: swapping back to old aggregation fixes per-layer scales and removes empties on the 10-sample test. still running full nightly to be sure. local command I used: 
```
python tools/run_calib.py --model rwd-llama3-13b --quant int8 --agg-method prev --calib-set summarization_small --out /tmp/calib-prev
python tools/run_eval.py --model rwd-llama3-13b-int8 --calib /tmp/calib-prev --evalset summarization_small
```

Liam O'Neil: if that's the case, safe short-term mitigation is to pin agg-method to prev for the nightly runners and open a proper bug/PR to tighten tests.

Eva Gomez: agree. I'll file an internal incident and request rollback for the quant-maint commit on staging. also will add an edge-case prompt to the nightly that checks for empty outputs.

Maya Chen: thanks. quant-ci-bot results: exp-1973001-prevagg -> ROUGE back to baseline, no empty outputs in sample. exp-1973001-forcecache -> still shows some empties (so caching doesn't mask the agg change).

Samir Patel: that suggests the aggregation algorithm itself changes the calibration distribution, not just timing. we'll need a unit test on per-layer scale variance and a small eval with the summarization prompts.

Olivia Park: I'll add the edge-case prompts to the nightly eval set and create a regression test that runs during CI quant profile PRs.

Maya Chen: action items: 1) Eva to rollback agg change in nightly config (ETA 30m). 2) Olivia to add edge-case prompts to nightly and CI tests (ETA EOD). 3) Samir + Maya to prepare a PR with new asserts and a longer repro harness. 4) Liam to draft a postmortem blurb for the retrospective.

Eva Gomez: rolling back now. will post when deploy finishes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

quant-ci-bot: exp-1973001-prevagg completed -> PASS. exp-1973001-forcecache completed -> FAIL (empty-output rate 6%).

Maya Chen: marking thread resolved-for-now once rollback is confirmed. leaving follow-ups open in the tracking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-1973

Liam O'Neil: nice triage. small note — we should add a per-layer scale histogram alert to infra so we get auto-paged if variance jumps >1.5x.

Samir Patel: agreed. tagging infra for an alert rule.

Olivia Park: thanks team. I'll add the CI test PR link once ready.

Maya Chen: thanks all :rocket:
